Semantic intents (1)

modify Remove special NFS item contracts from 2026-12-06REST breaking changesDownstream breaking changesAzure Guidelines

The change removes symbolic-link, block-device, character-device, FIFO, and socket item models, their XML collections, related NFS metadata, and special-file values. Directory listing and file creation retain their routes but lose nested response elements and accepted type values.

Affected REST operations (4)

Operation impact: 4 REST operations are affected; 3 representative operation(s) are shown below and 1 are omitted from HTML. The complete inventory is retained in assessment.json.

Directory_ListFilesAndDirectoriesSegment GET /{filesystem}/{directoryPath} 2026-12-06

The change removes symbolic-link, block-device, character-device, FIFO, and socket item models, their XML collections, related NFS metadata, and special-file values. Directory listing and file creation retain their routes but lose nested response elements and accepted type values.
